insect.basis: T1 or T2 cannot run: 30 covered hours with ambient < 48
insect.rule: supported: T2 partial CI lower > 0.30 AND T1 share <= 0.50; refuted: N_b>=5 AND T1 share >= 0.80 AND lift >= 1.25 AND Fisher p < 0.05 AND T2 partial CI upper < 0.30; needs >= 3 nights

pulser.basis: decisive verdicts refused: burst hours span 2 distinct nights (< 3)
pulser.rule: supported (clocked periodic source, internal OR external; cannot exclude unit electronics): eligible N>=5 AND >=80% periodic AND consistent lag >= 0.80 AND regular share >= 0.5; refuted: eligible N>=5 AND >=80% non-periodic AND clustered share >= 0.5; needs >= 3 nights

thermal.basis: decisive verdicts refused: burst hours span 2 distinct nights (< 3)
thermal.rule: supported: T8 runs AND rho CI lower > 0.30 AND p < 0.05; refuted: T8 CI upper < 0.30, or (T8 cannot run) basis ambient_proxy_only when T3 best CI upper < 0.30 AND >= 60% of burst hours |dT/dt| < 0.5; ambient alone never supports; needs >= 3 nights

electronics.basis: T2 and T3 cannot run, its refutation test is unavailable
electronics.rule: never supported from these logs; refuted: T2 partial CI lower > 0.30 OR T3 best CI lower > 0.30 (it predicts independence from outdoor conditions); residual when not refuted and T6 passes; needs >= 3 nights

insect.basis: T1 or T2 cannot run: 0 burst hours with ambient < 5; 0 covered hours with ambient < 48
insect.rule: supported: T2 partial CI lower > 0.30 AND T1 share <= 0.50; refuted: N_b>=5 AND T1 share >= 0.80 AND lift >= 1.25 AND Fisher p < 0.05 AND T2 partial CI upper < 0.30; needs >= 3 nights

pulser.basis: T4 cannot run: no burst hour with a periodicity test (fewer than 200 events or too many pairs)
pulser.rule: supported (clocked periodic source, internal OR external; cannot exclude unit electronics): eligible N>=5 AND >=80% periodic AND consistent lag >= 0.80 AND regular share >= 0.5; refuted: eligible N>=5 AND >=80% non-periodic AND clustered share >= 0.5; needs >= 3 nights

thermal.basis: T3 and T8 cannot run: largest dT/dt sample 0 hours < 72; 0 burst hours with board temperature coverage >= 0.8 < 5
thermal.rule: supported: T8 runs AND rho CI lower > 0.30 AND p < 0.05; refuted: T8 CI upper < 0.30, or (T8 cannot run) basis ambient_proxy_only when T3 best CI upper < 0.30 AND >= 60% of burst hours |dT/dt| < 0.5; ambient alone never supports; needs >= 3 nights

electronics.basis: T2 and T3 cannot run, its refutation test is unavailable
electronics.rule: never supported from these logs; refuted: T2 partial CI lower > 0.30 OR T3 best CI lower > 0.30 (it predicts independence from outdoor conditions); residual when not refuted and T6 passes; needs >= 3 nights

caveats: The transient records are a censored, detector-dependent proxy for the bursts (20 ms frames, total energy, gaps under 0.04 s unobservable), not the bursts themselves.
A supported verdict concerns the logged proxy only; it does not identify the source.
pulser supported means a clocked periodic source, internal or external; unit electronics with a clock are not excluded by it.
Ambient temperature is a model value for a cell of about 11 km, not a measurement at the unit.
The burst hours span 2 distinct nights: supported and refuted verdicts are refused below 3.
Hours before frozen_utc are exploratory: the rules were set after the author had seen them (a post-hoc fit).
